evidence: Deletes src/util/types.h, strips custom polyfills from src/util/expected.h, and replaces conditional builtins in src/compat/byteswap.h with standard library equivalents.
rationale: Retires custom compatibility polyfills for Expected, byteswap, and static assertions in favor of std primitives. The author notes that 'workarounds to avoid C++23 keep accumulating', making this a worthwhile reduction of internal utility maintenance overhead.
